people.name: Dev
observations: Second time seeing Dev, at dinner at a Thai place on Elm
Dev showed up wearing an old Talking Heads t-shirt
Talked with Dev for two hours straight
Dev played a song they had been working on, holding their phone between them at the table
The song was a bass-driven instrumental with weird time signature changes
Jordan said the song reminded them of Thundercat and Dev said that was the highest possible compliment
Dev asked about progress with Coda and Jordan showed them the new wireframes on their phone
Dev asked if the app could track unstructured 'noodling' practice without logging it piece by piece
Jordan and Dev sketched ideas for a 'free play' mode on a napkin
Dev tried to grab the check but they split it evenly
Jordan and Dev walked a few blocks together before heading different directions
Dev texted Jordan a bass cover of a Radiohead song after getting home with no context

projects.name: Coda
observations: Jordan showed Dev new wireframes for Coda on their phone
Dev suggested a feature to track unstructured practice time ('noodling')
Jordan and Dev sketched an idea for a 'free play' mode with a timer and optional tags after

places.name: Thai place on Elm
observations: Jordan and Dev had dinner here for their second time seeing each other
Jordan arrived early and almost left due to anxiety before Dev showed up
